title: Cactus in a pot
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Pot -->
  <path d='M30 72 L38 92 L62 92 L70 72 Z' fill='#E07040'/>
  <rect x='27' y='66' width='46' height='9' rx='3' fill='#F08850'/>
  <!-- Pot rim highlight -->
  <rect x='27' y='66' width='46' height='3' rx='2' fill='#F8A070'/>
  <!-- Soil -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='18' ry='4' fill='#7A4A2A'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='71' rx='16' ry='3' fill='#8B5A35'/>
  <!-- Main cactus body -->
  <rect x='40' y='30' width='20' height='42' rx='10' fill='#3CB84A'/>
  <!-- Cactus body lighter stripe -->
  <rect x='44' y='30' width='6' height='42' rx='3' fill='#5CD85A'/>
  <!-- Left arm -->
  <path d='M40 52 L30 52 Q24 52 24 46 L24 40 Q24 34 30 34 L32 34' fill='none' stroke='#3CB84A' stroke-width='9' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M40 52 L30 52 Q24 52 24 46 L24 40 Q24 34 30 34 L32 34' fill='none' stroke='#5CD85A' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Right arm -->
  <path d='M60 44 L68 44 Q74 44 74 38 L74 34 Q74 28 68 28 L66 28' fill='none' stroke='#3CB84A' stroke-width='9' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M60 44 L68 44 Q74 44 74 38 L74 34 Q74 28 68 28 L66 28' fill='none' stroke='#5CD85A' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Flower on top -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='28' r='5' fill='#FF4080'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='28' r='2.5' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <!-- Small spines -->
  <line x1='40' y1='42' x2='36' y2='42' stroke='#A8E8A0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='40' y1='54' x2='36' y2='54' stroke='#A8E8A0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='60' y1='38' x2='64' y2='38' stroke='#A8E8A0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='60' y1='58' x2='64' y2='58' stroke='#A8E8A0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='60' y1='50' x2='64' y2='50' stroke='#A8E8A0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Pot face (cute) -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='81' r='2.5' fill='#FFE0C0'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='81' r='2.5' fill='#FFE0C0'/>
  <path d='M46 86 Q50 89 54 86' fill='none' stroke='#FFE0C0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
